$comment: Generic, multilingual keyword lists of the route classifier (src/core/classify.ts). They apply to every feed:
train category tokens, brand and operator names that say long distance / regional / night / high speed, and the
wording of rail-replacement buses in each language. Rules for one operator or feed belong in an operator adapter

trainCategories.$comment: Alphabetic train category tokens (trip_short_name prefix, first word of route names), case-insensitive except longDistanceCaseSensitive.

categoryDisplayNames.$comment: Internal train category codes shown under the name the train is sold as (exact route short name / trip category). DB data (gtfs.de, DELFI) codes SNCF's TGV trains in Germany 'TGD'.

roadTripCategories.$comment: Trip categories that mean a road vehicle even on a rail route (route_type 2): bus / coach in any language (Irish Rail 'BUS123', French 'Car').

nightNames.$comment: Night trains by name or agency.

longDistanceOperators.$comment: Operators whose rail services are long distance whatever the route_type.

regionalOperators.$comment: Operators whose rail services are regional.

replacementNames.$comment: Rail-replacement / special buses by route name, description or agency: DE/AT/CH SEV, Schienenersatzverkehr, EV, Bahnersatz; NL (Snel/Stop)bus ipv trein, treinvervangend vervoer; DK togbus; NO buss for tog; SE ersättningsbuss / tågersättning; CZ / SK náhradní / náhradná doprava; PL ZKA; HU (vonat)pótló busz; IT bus / autobus sostitutivo; FR / BE bus de substitution / de remplacement; ES autobús sustitutorio / de sustitución.

replacementNamesCaseSensitive.$comment: Case-sensitive markers: CZ / SK NAD (náhradní autobusová doprava; 'nad' is also Czech 'above'), PL ZKA, SEV.

replacementHeadsigns.$comment: Trip headsigns of rail-replacement buses under an ordinary line ('Gera Hbf (SEV)', 'Nykøbing F St. (togbus)'). Stricter than the names: headsigns are place names ('Ev. Kirche', 'Planina/Sev.' must not match). Used in DuckDB regexp_matches, so no flags.

railLineCode.$comment: Line codes of trains (RE 7, RB81X, S1EV, MEX17E, IRE3): a bus route with such a name whose agency runs trains in the same country is a rail-replacement bus.

highSpeedBrands.$comment: Train brands built for high-speed lines (steer rail geometry only).

notHighSpeed.$comment: Brand names that look high-speed but are not ('OUIGO Train Classique').
